company: Holy Heights Tree and Stump Removal

reviews.text: Chad and team were great! They cleaned up my property, taking multiple trees and major pruning, and ground the stumps down. Professional, and Prompt! I would highly recommend Holy Heights. He’s a true Arborist and Craftsmen when it comes to trees.
reviews.author: Ben D.

reviews.text: We experienced storm damage, as many others in our area did on July 4th. We had 3 trees removed and 1 stump ground. Chad offered clear communication, competitive pricing, and he and his team did excellent work. They get an easy recommendation from me.
reviews.author: Von S.

reviews.text: We were recommended Holy Heights Tree service from some friends of ours. Great recommendation! We experienced good communication, fair prices, and high quality workmanship. Highly Recommend!
reviews.author: Ragen H.
